text:
Can Your Boss Text You When You’re Off The Clock? ⏱️
If you’re an hourly employee and you find yourself answering texts, emails, or requests from your boss while not on the clock, that’s actually considered work. You may be legally required to be paid for situations like that.
Don’t assume that unpaid labor is “part of the job.” You have rights and legal protection.
If this is you, make sure to track all work-related communication that takes place outside of your working hours, even quick messages. If your employer isn’t compensating you, that could violate wage and labor laws.
Follow for more employment law education so you can understand your rights as an employee!
